# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Management

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by the "Activities" button in the top-left corner of the screen)
- **Desktop Environment**: GNOME (indicated by the application dock on the left and system status icons on the top-right)
- **Window Manager**: Standard Linux window manager with minimize, maximize, and close buttons
- **Application Title Bar**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird" indicating an email composition window
- **System Time**: "Oct 23 18:09" displayed in the top-center of the screen
- **System Tray**: Contains icons for notifications, sound, and power management on the top-right

## Application Dock (Left Sidebar)

- **Application Icons** (from top to bottom):
  - Google Chrome (multicolored circular icon)
  - Thunderbird Mail (envelope icon)
  - Visual Studio Code (blue "VS" icon)
  - VLC Media Player (orange traffic cone icon)
  - LibreOffice Writer (blue document icon)
  - LibreOffice Calc (green spreadsheet icon)
  - LibreOffice Impress (orange presentation icon)
  - GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program, wildebeest icon)
  - File Manager (gray folder icon)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange shopping bag icon)
  - Help (blue question mark icon)
  - Trash (green recycle bin icon)
  - Application Grid (9-dot grid icon at the bottom)

## Thunderbird Mail Window

### Main Window Header

- **Title Bar**: "Sent - anonym-x2024@outlook.com - Mozilla Thunderbird"
- **Search Bar**: Located in the top-right of the main window, with a magnifying glass icon
- **Menu Bar**: Standard application menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help
- **Toolbar**: Contains quick action buttons: Send, Encrypt, Spelling, Save, Contacts, and Attach (with a dropdown)

### Email Composition Window

- **Window Title**: "Write: (no subject) - Thunderbird"
- **From Field**:
  - Pre-filled with "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>"
  - Dropdown arrow next to the email address for account selection
- **To Field**:
  - Empty text field with a blinking cursor, ready for input
  - Orange border indicating active focus
- **Cc Field**:
  - Empty field for carbon copy recipients
- **Bcc Field**:
  - Empty field for blind carbon copy recipients
- **Subject Field**:
  - Empty text field for the email subject
- **Formatting Toolbar**:
  - **Paragraph Dropdown**: For paragraph style selection
  - **Variable Width Dropdown**: For text width adjustment
  - **Text Formatting Buttons**: Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U)
  - **Alignment Buttons**: Left align, Center align, Right align
  - **List Buttons**: Unordered list, Ordered list
  - **Other Formatting**: Indent, Outdent, Font color, Background color
  - **Insertion Buttons**: Insert image, Insert link, Insert emoji

### Email Body

- **Text Area**: Large white space for composing the email body
- **Status Bar**: Located at the bottom of the composition window, showing "(co)" which may indicate a connection status or other system information

## Thunderbird Welcome Screen (Background)

- **Header**: "Welcome to FREEDOM" in large, bold text
- **Subheader**: "Thunderbird is a gift from thousands of people like you. We hope you'll enjoy the productivity, privacy, and freedom they make possible and we invite you to become part of that gift to others."
- **Donate Button**: Blue button with a heart icon and text "Donate" for supporting Thunderbird
- **Section 1: Free and Open Source**
  - Title: "Free and Open Source"
  - Subtitle: "Thunderbird is now yours forever."
  - Description: Explains that Thunderbird is developed openly and distributed freely, protecting user rights to use, modify, and share the software. Mentions the mission to protect privacy and freedom.
  - Button: "Get Help" with a hand icon
- **Section 2: Powered by Community**
  - Title: "Powered by Community"
  - Subtitle: "You can become part of our story."
  - Description: Encourages community contribution through donations, translations, answering questions, suggesting features, reporting bugs, etc.
  - Button: "Participate" with a pencil icon
- **Footer Message**: "Want new features sooner? Learn about Thunderbird Release." with a hyperlink to the release information

## System Status Icons

- **Top-Right Corner**:
  - Notification bell icon
  - Sound icon
  - Power button icon
  - Network connectivity icon
